A '''surveillance tagger''',<ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> also known as a '''sensor tag''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a small tracking device consisting of two distinct parts; the [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] and the tracker. The beacon was affixed to a target, usually pinned to clothing, magnetized,<ref name="CRFG" /> or via [[Dart/Legends|darts]].<ref name="EotECR" />

Each tagger had a dedicated tracker that was coded to receive the signal from a specific beacon.<ref name="CRFG" /> The beacon relayed information to the tracker about the target's location, direction, and rate of movement.<ref name="EotECR" /> The tagger, and the target it was attached to, could then be tracked from a safe distance.<ref name="EGWT" />

Surveillance taggers were primarily used as espionage tools by [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]], [[Private investigator/Legends|private investigators]], [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Spy/Legends|intelligence agents]].<ref name="EGWT" />

A variety of models were available on the open market, including [[Rhinsome Tracking Corporation/Legends|Rhinsome Tracking Corporation's]] [[SureSnoop]], [[MechBlaze Tracking Corp.]]'s [[Observer Mk. I]], and [[Astroserver Industries]]' [[Rover (surveillance tagger)|Rover]] and [[Trailmaster]].<ref name="EGWT" />
